chunks: Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ibn Ishaq al-Taleqani (may God be pleased with him) narrated that Abdul Aziz ibn Yahya al-Jaloodi said: Abu Hamid al-Taleqani narrated that Abdul Aziz ibn al-Khattab, from Tilid ibn Suleiman, from Layth, from Mujahid said:
Seventy verses of the Holy Quran were revealed concerning Ali (peace be upon him), in which none of the others share in their virtue.
ai.seo_question: How many verses of the Quran are said to have been revealed regarding Imam Ali's virtues?
ai.summary: In Shaykh al-Saduq’s *al-Khisal*, this hadith highlights the unique spiritual station of Imam Ali (peace be upon him) by asserting that seventy Quranic verses specifically pertain to his virtues, a distinction not shared by other companions. This claim underscores the Shia belief in Ali’s preeminent status among the Ahl al-Bayt and the broader community, reflecting the depth of his connection to divine revelation. The specificity of these verses serves as a theological foundation for his leadership and spiritual authority in Shia tradition.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 24-2 Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ibn Ishaq al-Taleqani - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Abdul Aziz ibn Yahya al-Jaloodi quoted Abu Hamid al-Taleqani, on the authority of Abdul Aziz ibn al-Khat’tab, on the authority of Tolid ibn Suleiman, on the authority of Layth, that Mujahid said,

“Seventy verses (of the Holy Quran) have been revealed about Ali (MGB) in which none of the other noble ones have any part.”The Reward of One who Implores Forgiveness Seventy Times in the Qunut of Al-Witr Prayer
